name: Adaptable
description: Humans make up for their lack of anything special by learning anything at all: +10% to every training gain.

name: Water breathing
description: Breathes underwater as easily as on land. Gills, or something like them.

name: Born swimmer
description: Swims faster than any human can run, and fights in the water without penalty.

name: Fish-Man Karate (unlock)
description: The body to learn Fish-Man Karate, the art of striking through the water inside an enemy. Needs a teacher.

name: Merfolk tail
description: Swift as anything in the water, slow and clumsy on land until the tail splits at thirty.

name: Electro
description: Every mink can channel electricity through their body and into a strike.

name: Sulong (moon-gated)
description: Under a full moon, a mink who looks at it may transform into a far stronger, far less controlled form.

name: Animal features
description: Ears, fur, a nose, a tail: the animal the mink descends from shows in every one of them.

name: Colossal body
description: Everything a giant needs is giant-sized: gear, food, doorways and ships.

name: Tiny
description: Small enough to hide in a teacup. A stealth bonus everywhere, but no human gear fits.

name: Mantra
description: Skypieans call it Mantra; the rest of the world calls it Observation Haki. It starts at level 1.

name: Lunarian wings
description: Black wings strong enough to fly with.

name: Lunarian flames
description: A flame burns at the back. While it burns, the body shrugs off blows that would kill anyone else.
